mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to market pessimism about economic slowdown.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not exceed 4.5% or 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE signals tightening labor market and higher interest rates, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE increase in the same month
failure_condition: The interaction of rising FEDFUNDS and UNRATE does not occur or returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: High demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) in a late-cycle expansion indicate market overvaluation, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO exceed 105% of their 2007 averages
failure_condition: Late-cycle expansion regime not active or returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 330 signals inflation concerns, prompting rate hikes and negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not exceed 330 or 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Surging employment (PAYEMS >160k) indicates strong labor market, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not exceed 160k or returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) and falling supply (INDPRO) signal a demand-driven rally, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Demand and supply interaction does not occur or returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS and HOUST (demand) together signal tightening policy and strong demand, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and HOUST increase in the same month
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and HOUST do not both rise or returns are not negative.
